name: Astrea
text: Beguile: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place 1 exhaustion token on a target unexhausted unit.

name: Call to Action
text: You may play this spell after an opponent declares attackers. Remove 1 exhaustion token from a target unit you control.

name: Devotion
text:
This spell can only be attached to a unit you control. When attaching this spell, remove 1 exhaustion token from this unit.

This unit now has the following abilities:

Alert: Do not place exhaustion tokens on this unit as a result of its countering.

Rooted: This unit cannot attack.

name: Imperial Ninja
text: Interrogate: When this unit is declared as an attacker, look at 1 random card in a target opponent's hand. That target player may discard 2 cards off the top of their draw pile. If they discard fewer than 2 cards, they must discard the looked at card.

name: Kneel
text: Place 1 exhaustion token on each unexhausted unit.

name: Light Bringer
text: Infatuate: When this unit comes into play, choose a target opponent. When choosing a main action during their next turn, that opponent must choose an Attack action if they control any units that can be declared as an attacker.

name: Mark of the Goddess
text: Choose a target unexhausted unit an opponent controls. Deal damage equal to the chosen unit's attack value to another target unit that opponent controls. If the chosen unit is the only unexhausted unit that opponent controls, you may deal that damage to their target Phoenixborn instead.

name: Royal Charm
text:
After you pay a cost using a charm or divine die on its power side, you may place that die on this spell if it has no dice on it.

[[side]] - [[exhaust]]: Choose a die on this spell and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

name: Steadfast Guardian
text:
Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

Alert: Do not place exhaustion tokens on this unit as a result of its countering.

name: Summon Light Bringer
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[divine:class]]: Place a [[Light Bringer]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Steadfast Guardian
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[charm:class]] - 1 [[divine:class]]: Place a [[Steadfast Guardian]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 1: You may remove all wound tokens and exhaustion tokens from a target Steadfast Guardian you control.

name: Summon Weeping Spirit
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[charm:class]]: Place a [[Weeping Spirit]] conjuration onto a target player's battlefield.

Focus 1: You may search a target discard pile for 1 card and remove it from the game.

name: Sun Sister
text: Care 1: [[side]]: Remove 1 wound token from another target unit you control.

name: Weeping Spirit
text:
Fearful: This unit cannot block.

Quell: [[side]] - 1 [[discard]]: Destroy this unit.
